Russian continues to strike Ukraine despite Trump's announcement of an 'energy ceasefire'
items.description: Russia attacks multiple power plants in Ukraine including in Kharkiv and the capital Kiev. The strikes were reported despite claims from US President Donald Trump that a so-called “energy ceasefire” is in place. Moscow has yet to comment on any potential deal while Ukrainian President Zelensky said the announcement cam…

items.title: ‘Energy ceasefire’: What’s behind Trump’s love-hate ties to Russian oil?
items.description: Trump's energy truce sparks criticism over aiding Russia's war finances amid diesel shortages and rising consumer costs.

items.title: Russia Plans Rehab Centers for Ukraine War Amputees
items.description: Russian officials are reporting growing demand for prosthetic limbs and rehabilitation among soldiers returning from Ukraine.

items.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine agree to an 'energy ceasefire'
items.description: President Trump said Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an "energy ceasefire," but he offered no details on it and Kyiv reported attacks by Moscow on energy sites after his statement.

items.title: Zelenskyy Says Ukraine Will Stop Refinery Attacks If Russia Halts Energy Strikes
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused Russia of striking an energy plant after US leader Donald Trump's surprise announcement of an “energy cease-fire,” while Moscow remained silent on any suggestion of a truce.

items.title: Watch: What's behind Trump's energy ceasefire claim?
items.description: The US president made the announcement in a social media post, which was an apparent surprise to Ukraine and Russia is yet to comment.

items.title: Von der Leyen, 'pieno sostegno a Zelensky, guerra in una fase più cupa'
items.description: 'Appoggio alla richiesta di cessate il fuoco, Russia in stallo sul campo'

items.title: Houthis, Saudis exchange strikes on airports as Mideast conflict intensifies
items.description: The Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen accuse Saudi Arabia of striking the rebel-held airport in Sanaa. This accusation comes amid escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed forces.

items.title: Saudi Arabia weighs response after Houthi attack on Riyadh, deadliest in a decade
items.description: A missile attack on the Saudi capital's international airport, launched from Houthi-controlled territory in Yemen, killed at least 12 people and injured 309 on Saturday, including a French national.

items.title: Houthi attack on Riyadh airport forces swift rethink of Trump’s new strategy

items.title: ‘These attacks must cease immediately’: Guterres condemns deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
items.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has condemned a Houthi missile attack on Riyadh’s main airport that Saudi authorities say killed 12 people and wounded more than 300.

items.title: Easing Diesel Sanctions Shows Weakness to Putin, Sybiha Says
items.description: Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha warned on Friday, Oct. 9, that easing sanctions on Russian diesel will not calm global energy markets or bring peace to Ukraine, arguing that Vladimir Putin interprets such steps as Western weakness. items.title: Eritrean troops in Ethiopia raise fears of a regional war
items.description: Ethiopia and Eritrea are trading blame for confrontations in Tigray amid international calls for restraint. Their respective allies have the potential to catapult the conflict into a regional war.
